visual_brief: Aconcagua is a broad, double-summited massif with horizontal rock bands, hanging glaciers and a huge south wall above dry Andean valleys. Classic views look up Horcones valley toward the snowy south face; aerial views reveal its full bulk, while western views expose more rock. Avoid confusing neighbouring Cerro Cuerno, Catedral or Bonete with Aconcagua.
notes: Six distinct photographs downloaded and visually checked; all exceed 2400 pixels on the long side. Prefer c1 for the classic view or c2 for an aerial alternative. Wrong-subject and obscured-summit candidates were discarded.
